response.sql: WITH account_counts AS (SELECT a.account_id, c.town_city, COUNT(ft.transaction_id) AS transaction_count FROM Accounts AS a JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id LEFT JOIN Financial_Transactions AS ft ON ft.account_id = a.account_id WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(c.town_city) <> '' GROUP BY a.account_id, c.town_city), totals AS (SELECT account_id, town_city, transaction_count, SUM(transaction_count) OVER (PARTITION BY town_city) AS town_transaction_count, AVG(transaction_count) OVER () AS average_transaction_count FROM account_counts) SELECT account_id, town_city, transaction_count, transaction_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(town_transaction_count, 0) AS town_transaction_share, transaction_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(average_transaction_count, 0) AS ratio_to_average FROM totals ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC, transaction_count DESC, account_id LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The average includes every account with a recorded holder and town, including accounts with zero transactions. A share or ratio with a zero denominator is NULL.

alternatives.interpretation: Compute the average across all accounts, including those excluded from the displayed results because their holder or town is missing.
alternatives.sql: WITH all_account_counts AS (SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(ft.transaction_id) AS transaction_count FROM Accounts AS a LEFT JOIN Financial_Transactions AS ft ON ft.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id), eligible AS (SELECT ac.account_id, c.town_city, ac.transaction_count FROM all_account_counts AS ac JOIN Accounts AS a ON a.account_id = ac.account_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(c.town_city) <> ''), town_totals AS (SELECT town_city, SUM(transaction_count) AS town_transaction_count FROM eligible GROUP BY town_city), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(transaction_count) AS average_transaction_count FROM all_account_counts) SELECT e.account_id, e.town_city, e.transaction_count, e.transaction_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(t.town_transaction_count, 0) AS town_transaction_share, e.transaction_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(o.average_transaction_count, 0) AS ratio_to_average FROM eligible AS e JOIN town_totals AS t ON t.town_city = e.town_city CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC, e.transaction_count DESC, e.account_id LIMIT 10
